question: What specialized nerve cells do the phylum Cnidaria possess to capture and stun prey such as water fleas and plankton?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sting cell**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Phylum Cnidaria possesses specialized nerve cells called **sting cells** or **nematocysts**.
 
• These cells are used to capture and stun prey such as water fleas and plankton.</l
